# ElevateBiz

> ElevateBiz builds AI agents that answer your customers 24/7, automates internal processes and develops custom software and AI-powered marketing for small businesses and enterprises. Plans from $300 USD. The website is available in English and Spanish, and the AI agent answers customers in both languages.

## Services

- AI customer agents: agents that answer every channel (including WhatsApp) like a real person, book appointments and follow up, 24/7.
- Process automation: reports, invoicing, data entry and the handoffs between your systems, so your team stops copying information.
- Custom software: web and mobile apps, internal software and AI agents built around how a company operates, integrated with the systems it already uses.
- AI-powered digital marketing: puts the business in front of new customers, and every lead that comes in is answered and followed up automatically.
